name: Shuukan Miyabi
source:
Worried that her daughter's shrine goddess powers might never awaken, 
queen Miyabi used a forbidden magic to glimpse into her daughter's future. 
What she saw was nothing but pain and suffering. 

Knowing that Shien was the cause of her daughter's future suffering, 
she secretly attempted to thwart him, but she made a mistake. 

Shien turned the tables and seized Miyabi and imprisoned her. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172702.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
担心女儿的神社巫女之力永远无法觉醒，女王雅决定使用禁忌魔法窥视女儿的未来。她看到的只有痛苦与折磨。

得知希恩是导致女儿未来受苦的原因后，她秘密尝试阻挠他，却犯下了错误。

希恩反客为主，抓住雅并将她囚禁。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172702.html]DLsite English[/url]）
